answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 25526 Country: Pakistan Title: Saying "Assalam o alikum" on SMS, or on chat at any web messenger, does it fall into the Fazilat of salam as mentioned in Hadiths ? Secondly is it necessary to reply for it ? Question: Assalam o alikum; Saying "Assalam o alikum" on SMS, or on chat at any web messenger, does it fall into the Fazilat of salam as mentioned in Hadiths ? Secondly is it necessary to reply for it ? Answer ID: 25526 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1513/1129/D=1431) (1) Whatever reward is of writing salam, the same is of writing in SMS with the intention of salam. (2) If one has to send the reply of SMS, it is necessary to send the reply of salam, otherwise it is not necessary to give the reply, but it is better to reply. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
